info.title: NXStationB Batocera
info.author: jiraiya78
info.details:
NXStation B is a Nintendo Switch port of Batocera EmulationStation. It sits next to NXStation on the same site: NXStation is the custom Borealis frontend; NXStation B is the Batocera UI running as an NRO.

What you get
Batocera systems, gamelists, detailed views, screensaver, and theme XML
Stock RetroArch Switch (retroarch_switch.nro + libnx cores). Rax is optional
ScreenScraper (your website login in settings; developer API is built in)
Bundled themes: Simple_Life (default), Minimal, Simple
Per-system core picker — including standalone NROs such as Tico
If you also use NXStation, playtime from B is logged into NXStation analytics
Returning from a game restores the last system and title, with a faster boot

Requirements
Atmosphere, Title Override (hold R on a game — not Album)
NXStationB.nro → sdmc:/switch/nxstationb/
ROMs in sdmc:/roms/{system}/
RetroArch Switch + cores on SD
